_comment: Copy to ~/.config/jev-use/usage-check.json and put YOUR providers in it.
usage-check ships with no providers: --live probes exactly what is listed here,
and nothing at all when this file is absent. No key lives in this file - it names
the environment variable (or the auth-file entry) that holds one.

wallets._comment: Flat balance field. `group` is for one wallet behind several keys.
wallets.name: Example: pay-per-use provider

wallets._comment: Credits pair (total_credits / total_usage), as OpenRouter returns.
wallets.name: Example: credits provider

_comment: Optional. A LiteLLM-compatible gateway answers /health?model=<id> with one real
completion per model. Omit this section and no route probe is attempted.
